newsitem.title: USA: Internet Communications sees Q2 above views.
newsitem.headline: Internet Communications sees Q2 above views.

text.p: Internet Communications Corp said Thursday it expects revenues for its second quarter ended July 31 to surpass Wall Street expectations.
Analysts consensus for the quarter is a loss per share of $0.05, according to First Call.

The company said it expects second quarter revenues to finish well above first quarter results. It said first quarter revenues were off plan that quarter, but actual net dollars in service revenues were running above plan.
The company said that trend has continued in the second quarter.
It also said it was "cautioning" shareholders that while its focus is on increasing service revenue, higher margin business takes time to build.
The company also said it expects the second quarter to reflect a strong hardware contribution.
